07 / TRANSPORTATION

Plan the movement of valuable materials with care.

The movement of mineral samples, gold and precious stones requires more than a shipping label. Packaging, declarations, identity checks and a clearly agreed handover matter from collection through delivery. Begin a conversation about the transportation arrangements appropriate to your material.

THE SERVICE IN CONTEXT

A defined scope leads to a better decision.

Explore shipment preparation, secure movement considerations and documented handover.

The suitable approach depends on the material, the intended outcome and the details agreed by the parties.

Make a service enquiry ↗
A CLOSER LOOK

What deserves attention.

Different specimen forms and questions call for different considerations. The following themes help frame the discussion.

01

A shipment begins with a sound plan

Material form, value, destination, packaging requirements and any relevant safety classification affect the transport approach. Before any movement, parties should agree on who prepares the shipment, who arranges carriage and how receipt is confirmed.

02

Documentation that travels with the material

Accurate consignor and consignee details, item descriptions, counts or weights and suitable supporting documentation make it easier to reconcile what was dispatched with what is received. Regulatory declarations and cross-border permits, where relevant, need to be addressed through authorised channels.

03

Security and handover points

High-value goods may call for secure carriers, tamper-evident packaging, insurance discussions, tracked transfers and clearly defined responsibilities. Transport arrangements should be confirmed case by case; an online enquiry does not book collection or insure a shipment.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

What to prepare.

A few useful details can make your first enquiry much more focused.

  • Material description and approximate value or quantity
  • Collection and destination areas
  • Packaging, piece count and approximate gross weight
  • Any relevant customs or ownership documentation
  • Preferred timeline and special handling considerations
Explore preparation guides ↗
COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Can I request collection through the website?+
The enquiry form starts a discussion. Collection is not scheduled without a separately confirmed arrangement.
Will my shipment automatically be insured?+
No. Insurance and liability terms must be specifically reviewed and agreed for any transport arrangement.
